observations: Multiple white plastic IBC (Intermediate Bulk Container) totes stacked outdoors.
Totes are reinforced with metal cage frames.
Some totes have red or blue ball valves at the top.
Some totes have spigots at the bottom.
A large black cylindrical tank is visible in the background.
Watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI BOLT WORLD' appears on all photos.
The environment appears to be a commercial yard or depot.

claims.claim: A chemical tank is a specialized container built to safely store, mix, or transport corrosive chemicals.
claims.evidence: The design of the IBC totes in the photos is standard for industrial chemical storage.

claims.claim: Food grade, used only once for clean water. No crack, no leak, lids complete.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this clearly enough to verify; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The totes may be expired or near the end of their service life (typically 10 years).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the manufacture or expiry date stamped on the plastic body.

risks.risk: The plastic may be thin or degraded, especially at the weld seams.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the seams and the bottom of the totes.

risks.risk: The valves or spigots may be leaking or clogged.
risks.proof: A video showing the valves being opened and closed, or a photo of the spigots with water flowing.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Clear photo of the manufacture or expiry date stamped on the plastic.
Close-up photos of the seams and the bottom of the totes.
Video of the valves being operated.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
